summary: AC Immune SA filed a Form 6-K announcing the retirement of CEO Dr. Andrea Pfeifer after 23 years, effective at the AGM on June 11, 2026. The Board appointed Chair Dr. Martin Zügel as Interim CEO, who resigned from committee roles, and appointed Dr. Monika Bütler as Lead Independent Director for governance. The filing details routine committee adjustments, not a forced departure or activist event. This is a planned CEO succession with an interim appointment, so it is classified as a management change but with medium confidence given the planned nature. No deal terms apply.
